Precondition: Config Tool open at Shift Schedules (/shifts)
Step: Create a new shift schedule (name, start, end, days-of-week, effective date)
Expected Result: Schedule saved with Name, StartTime, EndTime, DaysOfWeekBitmask (Mon=1..Sun=64), and EffectiveFrom; creation is audit-logged

Step: Configure First Shift (6:00am–2:00pm M–F) and Second Shift (2:00pm–10:00pm M–F)
Expected Result: Both schedules persist with correct times and a Mon–Fri days bitmask

Step: Create a schedule whose end time is earlier than its start time
Expected Result: Overnight shift (EndTime < StartTime) is accepted as valid

Step: Attempt to create another schedule with the same name
Expected Result: System rejects the duplicate with a clear message
Schedule is soft-deleted (DeprecatedAt), not overwritten; EffectiveFrom preserves the schedule across time

Step: Change its start/end time and save
Re-apply the schedule set with a revised sheet (updated + new rows)
Expected Result: Existing rows update and new rows add without duplicating (idempotent by unique name)
Notes: bulk spreadsheet import is a cutover step

Precondition: A shift schedule maintained in the Config Tool
Step: Make a manual edit after import
Expected Result: Manual Configuration Tool edit is audit-logged
